threshold_works_concession.note: Figure not printed in the PDF; published on the Procurement intranet page. To be supplied by the auditor.

threshold_light_touch.note: Figure not printed in the PDF; published on the Procurement intranet page. To be supplied by the auditor.

threshold_relevant.note: Used where the clause does not name a contract type; the applicable figure is one of the three above, by contract type. To be supplied by the auditor.

rules.condition: service contract with estimated value exceeding the Threshold for Goods & Services
rules.required_action: consider how the procurement might improve economic, social and environmental wellbeing (Social Value Act 2012)
rules.evidence_source: social value consideration recorded in the procurement file or award report
rules.verbatim_quote: where the estimated value exceeds the Threshold for Goods & Services, consideration must be given as to how the procurement or contract might improve the economic, social and environmental wellbeing of West Berkshire

rules.condition: any contract
rules.required_action: contract must rest on a decision of the Council, the Executive, or a decision maker under the Scheme of Delegation
rules.approver: the Council; the Executive; or an Executive Decision Maker, Council Committee or Sub-Committee, or officer within the Scheme of Delegation
rules.evidence_source: decision record or delegated decision for the contract
rules.verbatim_quote: All contracts must be in accordance with a decision:

rules.condition: any contract
rules.required_action: enter a contract only against an existing budget provision approved by the Council
rules.evidence_source: budget code and approved budget line for the contract
rules.verbatim_quote: No contract shall be entered into unless it is in accordance with an existing budgetary provision within the Budget approved by the Council.

rules.condition: contract award valued over £500,000
rules.required_action: treat the award as a Key Decision of the Council
rules.approver: the Council (Key Decision)
rules.evidence_source: Forward Plan entry and Key Decision record
rules.verbatim_quote: Any contract award with a value over £500,000 is a Key Decision of the Council.

rules.condition: Service Director lacks delegated authority to enter the contract
rules.required_action: obtain approval under Appendix A before award
rules.approver: approver set by Appendix A
rules.evidence_source: approval record under Appendix A dated before award
rules.verbatim_quote: Where a Service Director does not have delegated authority to enter into a contract, approval in accordance with Appendix A is required before the contract can be awarded.

rules.condition: invitation to tender for goods and/or services valued over £5,000
rules.required_action: publish details of the invitation to tender
rules.evidence_source: Transparency Code publication of tender invitations
rules.verbatim_quote: Details of every invitation to tender for contracts to provide goods and/or services with a value that exceeds £5,000.

rules.condition: all contracts in progress and awarded
rules.required_action: publish a register of contracts with value, duration and supplier
rules.evidence_source: published contract register
rules.verbatim_quote: A register of contracts, including those in progress and those awarded, with key information such as the contract value, duration and supplier.

rules.condition: contracts let by each service area
rules.required_action: report contract information to the relevant board monthly
rules.evidence_source: monthly contract reports to the relevant board
rules.verbatim_quote: Service areas are therefore responsible for reporting contract information to the relevant board on a monthly basis

rules.condition: any contract award
rules.required_action: check the supplier meets minimum standards of suitability, capability, legal status and financial standing
rules.evidence_source: supplier due-diligence and financial standing checks on the procurement file
rules.verbatim_quote: Officers undertaking procurement are responsible for ensuring that all persons awarded contracts for the supplies, services or works to the Council meet the Council's minimum standards of suitability, capability, legal status and financial standing.

rules.condition: contract opportunity above the relevant Procurement Legislation threshold
rules.required_action: advertise on the CDP before any other advertising medium (not needed for a Further Competition under a compliant Framework)
rules.evidence_source: CDP notice with publication date earlier than any other advert
rules.verbatim_quote: All contract opportunities which are above the relevant Procurement Legislation thresholds must be advertised on the CDP database

rules.condition: any CDP notice
rules.required_action: CDP notices approved and issued by the Service Lead for Procurement and Commissioning or delegate
rules.approver: Service Lead for Procurement and Commissioning or their delegate
rules.evidence_source: CDP notice issue record and approver
rules.verbatim_quote: CDP notices must be approved and issued by the Service Lead for Procurement and Commissioning or their delegate as appropriate

rules.condition: any contract
rules.required_action: do not split or disaggregate a contract to avoid the Procurement Legislation or the Rules
rules.evidence_source: spend and orders for the same supplier and requirement over time
rules.verbatim_quote: There shall be no artificial splitting or disaggregation of a contract to avoid the application of the provisions of the Procurement Legislation and/or these Rules.

rules.condition: contract with estimated value more than the appropriate Threshold
rules.required_action: issue an electronic Invitation to Tender and receive tenders electronically via the Procurement Portal
rules.evidence_source: Procurement Portal ITT and tender submission log
rules.verbatim_quote: An electronic Invitation to Tender shall be issued by the Council for all contracts with an estimated value that is more than the appropriate Threshold and tenders shall be submitted electronically by tenderers via the Council's Procurement Portal.

rules.condition: electronic tenders
rules.required_action: specify the tender format and hold tenders in a locked secure portal account until the opening time
rules.evidence_source: Procurement Portal tender lock and opening log
rules.verbatim_quote: tenders shall be stored in a secure portal account which is locked until the date and time specified for its opening.

rules.condition: tender received after the specified opening time
rules.required_action: do not accept a late tender unless the Monitoring Officer is satisfied the circumstances are exceptional and other tenders are unopened
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer
rules.evidence_source: Procurement Portal receipt times; Monitoring Officer decision on any late tender
rules.verbatim_quote: No tender received after the time and date specified for its opening shall be accepted or considered by the Council unless the Monitoring Officer is satisfied that there are exceptional circumstances and the other tenders have not been opened.

rules.condition: tenders submitted on the Procurement Portal
rules.required_action: open tenders electronically by a Procurement Officer, with an audit record kept
rules.evidence_source: e-tendering system audit record of tender opening
rules.verbatim_quote: The electronic opening of tenders submitted on the Procurement Portal shall be conducted by a Procurement Officer with an audit record being maintained on the e-tendering system.

rules.condition: any quote or tender evaluation
rules.required_action: evaluate against criteria notified in advance to bidders
rules.evidence_source: invitation documents showing criteria; evaluation record
rules.verbatim_quote: All quotes and tenders shall be evaluated in accordance with evaluation criteria notified in advance to those submitting quotes/tenders.

rules.condition: any contract award
rules.required_action: award on most advantageous / best value basis, not lowest price only, unless an exception is approved in advance
rules.approver: relevant Service Director (for exceptions, in advance)
rules.evidence_source: award report with evaluation basis; Service Director approval of any exception
rules.verbatim_quote: Save in exceptional circumstances approved in advance by the relevant Service Director all contracts shall be awarded on the basis of the quote or tender which is most advantageous and represents best value for money to the Council

rules.condition: waiver or exception of competition for a contract valued more than £24,999.99
rules.required_action: waive competition only in the circumstances of 7.2.1 (urgency) or 7.2.2 (Executive Director/Chief Executive discretion with reasons recorded in writing)
rules.evidence_source: exception or waiver record stating the circumstance relied on and written reasons
rules.verbatim_quote: Subject to 7.4 the requirement for the Council to conduct a competitive purchasing process, contracts with a value of more than £24,999.99, may be excepted or waived in the following circumstance:

rules.condition: any waiver or exception to the Rules
rules.required_action: waiver or exception granted only by the Monitoring Officer and/or S.151 Officer, sought in advance and only in exceptional circumstances
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer and/or S.151 Officer
rules.evidence_source: waiver record with approver and date before the purchase
rules.verbatim_quote: Only the Monitoring Officer and/or the S.151 Officer may grant a waiver or an exception to these Rules

rules.condition: exception for a contract up to the Threshold
rules.required_action: S.151 Officer approves the exception
rules.approver: S.151 Officer
rules.evidence_source: exception approval by the S.151 Officer
rules.verbatim_quote: for all contracts up to the Threshold, the S.151 Officer must approve the exception;

rules.condition: exception for a contract above the relevant Threshold and up to £500,000
rules.required_action: S.151 Officer consults the Monitoring Officer and Executive Director; exception report approved by the relevant board (retrospectively only for urgency)
rules.approver: S.151 Officer with Monitoring Officer and Executive Director; relevant board
rules.evidence_source: exception report and board approval minute
rules.verbatim_quote: for contracts above the relevant Threshold and up to £500,000, the S.151 Officer will consult with the Monitoring Officer and the appropriate Executive Director

rules.condition: exception for a contract over £500,000
rules.required_action: S.151 Officer and Monitoring Officer recommend to the Executive; exception report approved by the relevant board and Corporate Board
rules.approver: the Executive (on recommendation of the S.151 Officer and Monitoring Officer); relevant board and Corporate Board
rules.evidence_source: exception report; board and Corporate Board approvals; Executive decision
rules.verbatim_quote: for contracts over £500,000 the S.151 Officer and the Monitoring Officer will make a recommendation to the Executive provided an exception report has been prepared and approved by the relevant board and Corporate Board.

rules.condition: any exception or waiver
rules.required_action: document the exception or waiver fully
rules.evidence_source: exception/waiver file
rules.verbatim_quote: All exceptions or waivers to these Rules must: … be fully documented;

rules.condition: exception or waiver where competition is not excluded by the Procurement Legislation
rules.required_action: submit a written exception report with reasons to the relevant board in advance
rules.approver: relevant board
rules.evidence_source: written exception report and board submission date
rules.verbatim_quote: be subject to a written exception report to be submitted in advance to the relevant board

rules.condition: any exception or waiver
rules.required_action: S.151 Officer approves and records that the circumstances are genuinely exceptional
rules.approver: S.151 Officer
rules.evidence_source: S.151 Officer approval record with reasons considered
rules.verbatim_quote: be subject to approval by the S.151 Officer who shall record they have considered the reasons for the waiver and that they are satisfied that the circumstances justifying the waiver are genuinely exceptional

rules.condition: use of a Purchasing Scheme (framework, DPS, consortium, etc.)
rules.required_action: seek advice confirming entitlement, coverage and compliance before using the scheme
rules.evidence_source: advice record on the procurement file before call-off
rules.verbatim_quote: An officer responsible for a procurement exercise may use a Purchasing Scheme provided that they have sought advice to confirm that:

rules.condition: contract awarded above the Threshold and subject to the Procurement Legislation
rules.required_action: Service Director produces a written procurement report for the contract
rules.evidence_source: written procurement report on the contract file
rules.verbatim_quote: A written report in accordance with the Procurement Legislation shall be produced by the relevant Service Director for each contract that is awarded which is above the Threshold and subject to the Procurement Legislation

rules.condition: procurement report under 9.1
rules.required_action: keep the report for three years
rules.evidence_source: retained 9.1 report
rules.verbatim_quote: This report may be requested by the Cabinet Office and shall be kept for three years.

rules.condition: all procurement procedures regardless of value
rules.required_action: document the procurement's progress and keep the documents for three years from award
rules.evidence_source: procurement file: communications, documents, evaluation and award records
rules.verbatim_quote: Such documentation must be kept for three years from the award of the contract.

rules.condition: any purchase
rules.required_action: keep written (including electronic) evidence of the purchase
rules.evidence_source: purchase order, invoice or contract
rules.verbatim_quote: There should be written evidence of all purchases (which shall include electronic evidence).

rules.condition: contracts listed in Appendix B
rules.required_action: contract in writing in a form approved by the Monitoring Officer
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer or their delegated officer
rules.evidence_source: signed written contract on an approved form
rules.verbatim_quote: All contracts entered into by the Council as detailed in Appendix B must be in writing in a form approved by the Monitoring Officer or their delegated officer.

rules.condition: award of any contract
rules.required_action: notify the Service Lead for Commissioning and Procurement so the contract is recorded on the Contract Register
rules.evidence_source: Council Contract Register entry and award notification
rules.verbatim_quote: The relevant Service Director must formally notify the Service Lead for Commissioning and Procurement (or nominated officer) of the award of all contracts for the purpose of it being recorded on the Council Contract Register.

rules.condition: any contract
rules.required_action: include the standard clauses from the relevant Standard Form of Agreement
rules.evidence_source: signed contract compared with the Standard Form of Agreement
rules.verbatim_quote: Every contract shall include the standard clauses set out in the relevant Standard Form of Agreement

rules.condition: amended Standard Form of Agreement
rules.required_action: amended contract form approved by the Monitoring Officer
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer or their delegated officer
rules.evidence_source: Monitoring Officer approval of the amended form
rules.verbatim_quote: Where a Standard Form of Agreement is to be amended, the form of contract shall be prepared/amended by the relevant Service Director for approval by the Monitoring Officer or their delegated officer.

rules.condition: any contract, where appropriate
rules.required_action: include minimum clauses: scope, timing, quality, insurance, remedies, legislation, data, bribery, payment terms
rules.evidence_source: signed contract terms
rules.verbatim_quote: As a minimum, where appropriate, all contracts shall include clauses setting out:

rules.condition: any contract
rules.required_action: complete a Data Protection Impact Assessment
rules.evidence_source: DPIA on the contract file
rules.verbatim_quote: Service Directors must ensure that a Data Protection Impact Assessment is completed for all contracts to inform such clauses.

rules.condition: any contract
rules.required_action: include relevant specifications or technical requirements
rules.evidence_source: contract specification
rules.verbatim_quote: All contracts shall include relevant specifications and/or briefs/technical requirements

rules.condition: any relaxation of full indemnities
rules.required_action: relaxation authorised in writing by the Monitoring Officer and the S.151 Officer
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer and S.151 Officer (or nominated officers)
rules.evidence_source: written authorisation of the relaxed indemnity
rules.verbatim_quote: No relaxation of full indemnities releasing the Council from all liability whether provided by public liability insurance or other instrument shall be allowed unless authorised in writing by the Monitoring Officer and the S.151 Officer or their nominated officers.

rules.condition: contract with a performance bond
rules.required_action: bond in a form approved by Legal Services and included in the Invitation to Tender
rules.approver: Legal Services
rules.evidence_source: bond form approval; Invitation to Tender
rules.verbatim_quote: The bond must be in a form approved by Legal Services and must be included in the Invitation to Tender.

rules.condition: performance bond judged not necessary
rules.required_action: undertake a written risk assessment
rules.evidence_source: written risk assessment
rules.verbatim_quote: undertake a risk assessment in writing; and

rules.condition: performance bond judged not necessary
rules.required_action: seek approval from the Service Director for Finance and Property
rules.approver: Service Director for Finance and Property
rules.evidence_source: approval record
rules.verbatim_quote: seek approval from the Service Director for Finance and Property; and

rules.condition: performance bond judged not necessary
rules.required_action: keep the risk assessment on the contract file
rules.evidence_source: contract file
rules.verbatim_quote: keep a copy of the risk assessment on the contract file for inspection.

rules.condition: risk assessment identifies the need for insurance
rules.required_action: set adequate insurance cover levels with the Service Director for Finance and Property
rules.evidence_source: insurance requirements in the contract
rules.verbatim_quote: set adequate levels of insurance cover (including employer's liability, public liability and any other as determined by the needs of the particular contract);

rules.condition: risk assessment identifies the need for insurance
rules.required_action: ensure the contractor holds the insurances and policies are up to date
rules.evidence_source: contractor insurance certificates on file
rules.verbatim_quote: ensure that such insurances are held by the contractor and that the policies concerned are up to date

rules.condition: contract requiring professional and/or design services
rules.required_action: set a case-by-case professional indemnity insurance level
rules.evidence_source: professional indemnity requirement in the contract
rules.verbatim_quote: set an appropriate level of professional indemnity insurance for each specific contract that require professional and/or design services

rules.condition: contract for goods, services, works or concessions valued above Threshold
rules.required_action: seal the contract
rules.evidence_source: sealing register entry for the contract
rules.verbatim_quote: All contracts whether for goods, services, works or concession contracts the value of which is above Threshold shall be sealed.

rules.condition: total contract value up to the relevant Threshold
rules.required_action: award by the relevant Service Director or officers they nominate in writing
rules.approver: Relevant Service Director (or officers nominated in writing)
rules.evidence_source: award decision and written nomination
rules.verbatim_quote: up to relevant Threshold … Relevant Service Director (or such officers as nominated by the Service Director in writing) shall have delegated authority to award the contract.

rules.condition: above the relevant threshold and less than £500,000
rules.required_action: award by the Service Director after S151 and Monitoring Officer recommendation, with a written report approved by the relevant board
rules.approver: Relevant Service Director following recommendation of the S151 officer and Monitoring Officer; relevant board
rules.evidence_source: written award report and board approval
rules.verbatim_quote: Above the relevant threshold and less than £500,000 … Relevant Service Director (following recommendation of the S151 officer and Monitoring Officer) shall have delegated authority to award the contract provided a written report by the relevant Service Director (or such officers as nominated by them in writing) has been provided and approved by the relevant board.

rules.condition: above £500,000 and less than £2.5million
rules.required_action: Key Decision by the Service Director with the Portfolio Holder, with a written report approved by the relevant board
rules.approver: relevant Service Director in consultation with the relevant Portfolio Holder (Key Decision); relevant board
rules.evidence_source: Key Decision record, Forward Plan entry and board-approved report
rules.verbatim_quote: Above £500,000 and less than £2.5million … The award of these contracts shall be a Key Decision delegated to the relevant Service Director in consultation with the relevant Portfolio Holder

rules.condition: £2.5million or more
rules.required_action: Executive approval
rules.approver: the Executive
rules.evidence_source: Executive decision or quarterly delegation report
rules.verbatim_quote: Contracts with a value in excess of £2.5million shall require Executive approval

rules.condition: total value exclusive of VAT above £1,000 and less than £25,000
rules.required_action: seek at least one quote from an appropriate source
rules.evidence_source: quote on the purchase file
rules.verbatim_quote: Above £1,000 and less than £25,000 … At least one quote must be sought from an appropriate source.

rules.condition: goods and services, £25,000 or more and less than the Threshold
rules.required_action: invite quotes via the Procurement Portal from at least three sources (incl. an SME/VCSE and a local supplier where appropriate); publish a contract notice on the CDP
rules.evidence_source: Procurement Portal RFQ record with invitee list; CDP contract notice
rules.verbatim_quote: £25,000 or more and less than the Threshold … Invitations to quote must be sent via the Procurement Portal to at least three appropriate sources, … A contract notice must be published on the CDP

rules.condition: works, concession and light touch contracts, £25,000 or more and less than £500,000
rules.required_action: invite quotes via the Procurement Portal from at least three sources (incl. an SME/VCSE and a local supplier where appropriate); publish a contract notice on the CDP
rules.evidence_source: Procurement Portal RFQ record with invitee list; CDP contract notice
rules.verbatim_quote: £25,000 or more and less than £500,000 … Invitations to quote must be sent via the Procurement Portal to at least three appropriate sources, … A contract notice must be published on the CDP

rules.condition: works, concession and light touch contracts above £500,000 and less than the Threshold
rules.required_action: full competitive tender with at least five written tenders sought via the Procurement Portal; advert on the Portal with information on the CDP
rules.evidence_source: Procurement Portal tender record (at least five invited); Portal advert and CDP information
rules.verbatim_quote: Above £500,000 and less than the Threshold … Full competitive tender process applies and at least five written tenders must be sought via the Procurement Portal.

rules.condition: any contract above the Threshold
rules.required_action: follow Procurement Legislation procedures: full competitive tender with at least five written tenders sought where appropriate; advert on the CDP
rules.evidence_source: Procurement Portal tender record; CDP advert
rules.verbatim_quote: Procurement Legislation Procedures apply– full competitive tender process with at least five written tenders sought (where appropriate) via the Procurement portal.

rules.condition: competition excluded because the contract is excluded under the Procurement Legislation
rules.required_action: prior written approval from the Monitoring Officer, and relevant board approval where applicable
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer; relevant board where applicable
rules.evidence_source: Monitoring Officer prior written approval
rules.verbatim_quote: The proposed contract is excluded under the Procurement Legislation. … Prior written approval from the Monitoring Officer is required

rules.condition: contract governed by the Provider Selection Regime (PSR)
rules.required_action: record key decisions and follow the PSR process
rules.evidence_source: PSR decision record
rules.verbatim_quote: Where the contract is governed by the Provider Selection Regime (PSR) … Key decisions must be recorded and the relevant process under PSR followed

rules.condition: award under a Purchasing Scheme with no further competition
rules.required_action: prior written approval from the Monitoring Officer, and relevant board approval where applicable
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer; relevant board where applicable
rules.evidence_source: Monitoring Officer prior written approval
rules.verbatim_quote: The proposed contract is being awarded under a Purchasing Scheme (refer to 8 above) … Prior written approval from the Monitoring Officer is required

rules.condition: extension of an existing contract that provides for the extension
rules.required_action: obtain S151 Officer approval for the extension
rules.approver: S151 Officer
rules.evidence_source: S151 Officer approval record
rules.verbatim_quote: The proposed contract is an extension to an existing contract where the existing contract provides for such extension. … Approval of the S151 Officer

rules.condition: variation of an existing contract, contract value below the Threshold
rules.required_action: prior written approval from the Monitoring Officer and S151 Officer
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer and S151 Officer
rules.evidence_source: prior written approvals for the variation
rules.verbatim_quote: The proposed contract is a variation of the scope of an existing contract … For contract value below the Threshold prior written approval from the Monitoring Officer and S151 Officer is required.

rules.condition: variation of an existing contract, contract value greater than the Threshold
rules.required_action: approval of the relevant board after a report with Monitoring Officer and S151 recommendation
rules.approver: relevant board
rules.evidence_source: board report and approval minute
rules.verbatim_quote: The proposed contract is a variation of the scope of an existing contract … For contract value greater than the Threshold, approval of the relevant board

rules.condition: social care placement or package awarded under the row F exclusion
rules.required_action: record the reasons for the choice of provider on the individual's case notes
rules.evidence_source: individual case notes
rules.verbatim_quote: Service Directors must ensure that a record of the reasons for the choice of provider is maintained on the individual's case notes.

rules.condition: exclusion applied to a contract with annual or total value more than the Threshold
rules.required_action: relevant board approves the contract
rules.approver: relevant board
rules.evidence_source: board approval minute
rules.verbatim_quote: In the interests of clarity where an exemption is applied all contracts with an annual or total value of more than the Threshold must be approved by the relevant board.

notes.issue: No Threshold figure is printed anywhere; the Rules point to the intranet, so every rule bounded by 'the Threshold' needs the auditor to supply the figure.
A value of exactly £500,000 falls in no band: rows end at 'less than £500,000' and the next start 'Above £500,000'.
Row A starts 'Above £1,000'; no procedure is stated for purchases of £1,000 or less.
7.2 uses 'more than £24,999.99' (printed in pence) while Appendix B uses '£25,000 or more'; same boundary written two ways.
7.2.2 lets an Executive Director or the Chief Executive proceed at their discretion, but 7.3 says only the Monitoring Officer and/or S.151 Officer may grant an exception.
Placeholders left in the text: the title 'Part []' and 'Parts [] (Call-In) and [] (Forward Plan)' in App A row 3.
Footnote *** is defined but its marker is not used in the Appendix B table, which uses only *, ** and ****.
Rows B2 and C group works, concession and light touch contracts, which have different Thresholds, so 'less than the Threshold' in row C has no single figure.
6.23 is a numbered heading ('Evaluations of Quotes and Tenders') with no content.
5.2 and 5.2.1 read as further items of the 5.1 'councils must publish' list but are numbered as separate clauses.
Row E covers variations but asks for an 'extension report' to the relevant board.
Row C reads 'no further competition is being undertaken a competition has already been undertaken'; a word appears to be missing.
7.4.2 reads 'Executive Director provided and an exception report'; the condition is garbled.
11.2 only says a bond 'should' be considered over £500,000, yet 11.4 imposes mandatory steps when a bond is not considered necessary.
Row 4's value column says '£2.5million or more' but its text says 'in excess of £2.5million'; a value of exactly £2.5million is treated two ways.
11.5.3 is garbled ('in consultation with ... who must ensure the contractor's status'); the responsible officer and the action are unclear.
